column1: # Panel C source. Genomic-position composition of CTCF sites across ALL TEN deciles of
# normalised occupancy change. decile_rank 1 = most binding lost, 10 = binding gained.
# Uses every one of the 40,312 peaks with a callable CTCF core motif; no group is selected.
# Percentages sum to 100 within each decile (linear axis, deliberately).
# Rebuilt 2026-08-01. Two earlier versions are superseded: a log odds-ratio forest plot
# (three failed axis attempts), and a two-group bar chart comparing decile 1 against
# decile 10 only. The two-group version discarded 80% of the data and labelled decile 10
# 'retained' when 100% of its peaks GAINED signal (median +0.48 log2 = 1.40-fold up),
# which also inflated the promoter contrast to 15.5 vs 59.9 percent; against all other
# sites the honest contrast is 15.5 vs 35.2 percent.
